第五十章 焚道碎天地血镜启轮回（第1页）
五重天罚尽数溃败，天道威严扫地，始祖彻底失去所有耐心。
他不再循序渐进、不再试探消磨，直接引爆第六重终极杀劫！
漫天云层瞬间化作赤红火海，熊熊天道焚火贯穿虚空，灼热的毁灭气息碾压万古，连周遭的时空都被烧得扭曲褶皱。
此劫，焚圣脉、焚龙气、焚人道、焚圣道，焚烧一切逆道本源，磨灭所有超脱天道的异数！
烈火焚天，道基尽毁，是足以焚烧一方天地的终极浩劫！
滚滚焚天火海轰然坠落，穿透虚空，直压万世护生大阵！
大阵剧烈震颤，表层灵光飞速灼烧黯淡，无数灵纹被天道焚火点燃、寸寸碎裂。
护生大阵乃二人本源所化，大阵受损，两人同时心口剧痛，气血翻涌，嘴角齐齐渗出血色。
“大阵快撑不住了！”沈清鸢眸光凝重。
本源透支、五重劫力缠身，再遇焚道天火，他们的护体道基已然濒临极限。
始祖居高临下，狞笑着俯瞰狼狈二人：
“我看你们还怎么护苍生！怎么守羁绊！”
“焚道天火专克你人圣双道！今日烧碎你们的道基，焚尽你们的本源！”
漫天火海层层碾压，即将彻底撕裂护生大阵、倾覆人间盛世！
千钧一发之际，萧聿辞骤然抬眸，眼底金龙万丈爆发！
沈清鸢应声抬手，万年圣脉尽数解封，所有残留本源、所有共生之力，毫无保留彻底爆发！
一金一白两道极致洪流冲天而起，不再防御，转而极致猛攻！
人道皇权镇压天火，圣道灵光净化焚劫！
两道力量交织成一柄横贯天地的无双长剑，逆势斩向漫天焚天火海！
惊天剑芒撕裂赤色火海，斩断焚道规则，碾压万古天罚！
漫天熊熊天火，被一剑劈散、熄灭、归零！
濒临破碎的护生大阵，瞬间被残余圣光龙气修复稳固，再度隔绝天外浩劫！
长空之上的始祖被反噬的余威狠狠震飞，血色半体裂痕遍布、煞气大损，千年修为重创大半！
他狼狈悬浮在血色云层之间，满目猩红、极致怨毒。
六重天劫，倾尽天道杀伐之力，竟奈何不得这对人间男女！
可转瞬，他忽然癫狂大笑，笑声阴冷刺骨，响彻万里天地：
“好好好！六重天劫都杀不死你们！”
“本座承认，你们的羁绊、你们的实力，超脱万古！”
虚空深处，一面斑驳古老、刻满万年轮回纹路的血色古镜，缓缓浮出天穹！
镜面流转无尽血色轮回光影，倒映出万载一代代圣女殉道的悲惨宿命！
“我筹谋万年的终极杀招，从不是天道劫罚！”
“今日，我以轮回古镜为基，以万千圣女怨念为火，以天地浩劫为引！”
“三重葬天劫落，轮回彻底闭环！我看你们，如何逆天！如何破局！”
血色古镜高悬九天，万古轮回之力彻底苏醒。
剩余三重终极灭世大劫，层层蓄势，万古终局之战，彻底抵达最凶险的绝境！
万年轮回闭环在即，终极宿命决战，真正开启！

Chapter 50: The Burning Dao Shatters the Heaven and Earth and the Blood Mirror Initiates Reincarnation (Page 1)
The five levels of heavenly punishment were all defeated, the majesty of heavenly law was wiped out, and the ancestors completely lost all patience.
He no longer proceeds step by step, no longer tests and wastes time, and directly detonates the sixth level of ultimate murder!
The clouds all over the sky instantly turned into a sea of ​​crimson fire, and the blazing fire of heaven penetrated the void. The scorching aura of destruction crushed the eternity, and even the surrounding time and space were burned into distortions and folds.
In this calamity, burn the holy veins, burn the dragon energy, burn the human way, burn the holy way, burn the origin of all contrary ways, and destroy all the anomalies that transcend the heavenly way!
Fierce fire burns the sky and destroys all the foundations of the Dao. It is the ultimate catastrophe that can burn down a whole world!
The rolling sky-burning sea of ​​fire crashed down, penetrated the void, and directly pressed against the eternal life-protecting formation!
The formation trembled violently, the spiritual light on the surface quickly burned and dimmed, and countless spiritual patterns were ignited by the fire of heaven and shattered inch by inch.
The formation for protecting students was formed from the origins of the two of them. When the formation was damaged, both of them felt severe pain in their hearts at the same time, their energy and blood surged, and blood oozed from the corners of their mouths.
"The formation can no longer hold up!" Shen Qingyuan's eyes were solemn.
Their origins were overdrawn, entangled with five levels of calamity, and when they encountered the Burning Heavenly Fire again, their body-protecting foundation was already on the verge of reaching its limit.
The ancestor stood down from a high place, looking down at the embarrassed two people with a ferocious smile:
"I see how you can protect the common people! How can you keep your bonds!"
"The Burning Dao and Heavenly Fire are designed to conquer your human and holy paths! Today, your Dao foundation will be burned to pieces and your origins will be burned away!"
The sky is filled with fire and the sea is crushing layer by layer, and is about to completely tear apart the life-protecting formation and overturn the prosperous world of the world!
At the critical moment, Xiao Yuci suddenly raised his eyes, and golden dragons erupted in his eyes!
Shen Qingyuan raised his hand in response, and all the ten thousand-year holy veins were unsealed. All the remaining origins and all the symbiotic power were completely exploded without reservation!
Two extreme torrents, one gold and one white, soared into the sky, no longer defending, but turning to the extreme attack!
The imperial power of humanity suppresses the heavenly fire, and the spiritual light of the holy way purifies the burning calamity!
The two forces intertwined into an unparalleled long sword that spanned the sky and the earth, bucking the trend and slashing towards the sky-burning sea of ​​fire!
The shocking sword light tears through the sea of ​​red fire, cuts off the rules of burning, and crushes the eternal punishment!
The blazing fire in the sky was split, extinguished, and returned to zero by a sword!
The health-protecting formation that was on the verge of being broken was instantly repaired and stabilized by the remaining holy light dragon energy, once again blocking the catastrophe from the outside!
The ancestor above the sky was severely knocked away by the backlash. The blood-colored half of his body was covered with cracks, the evil spirit was greatly damaged, and most of his thousand-year cultivation was severely damaged!
He was suspended between the blood-colored clouds in an awkward state, his eyes full of scarlet red and extremely malicious.
The sixth level of heavenly calamity, with all the killing power of heaven, could do nothing to stop this human man and woman!
But in an instant, he suddenly laughed maniacally, his laughter was cold and bone-chilling, resounding throughout the world:
"Okay, okay! Even the six heavenly tribulations can't kill you!"
"I admit that your bond and your strength are beyond eternity!"
Deep in the void, an ancient, mottled, blood-colored mirror engraved with patterns of reincarnation slowly emerged from the sky!
The endless bloody light and shadow of reincarnation flow on the mirror, reflecting the tragic fate of martyrdom of saints from generation to generation!
"The ultimate killing move that I have been planning for thousands of years is never a tribulation from heaven!"
"Today, I use the ancient mirror of reincarnation as the foundation, the resentment of thousands of saints as the fire, and the catastrophe of heaven and earth as the guide!"
"The triple heaven-burial catastrophe has fallen, and the cycle of reincarnation has completely closed! Let me see how you go against the will of heaven! How you break the situation!"
The bloody ancient mirror hangs high in the sky for nine days, and the power of eternal reincarnation is completely awakened.
The remaining three levels of ultimate world-destroying catastrophe are gathering momentum, and the eternal final battle has completely reached the most dangerous and desperate situation!
The cycle of reincarnation is about to close, and the ultimate fateful battle has truly begun!
